paragraphs.text: See capability requirements, strengths, gaps, alignment, and development needs in context.
Define what the objective requires from roles, skills, knowledge, systems, and support.
See which existing capabilities already support the work.
Identify the missing or weak capabilities most likely to constrain the objective.
Define a target role or development direction, connect it to current skills and gaps, and keep the pathway responsive to changing requirements, learning progress and relevant opportunities.
